notes: Local TUI target is fixture-level, not live: the API shape and event mapping are fixture-tested only.
Connector is app-side and read-only: it reads /api/session/active plus per-session execution detail, permissions, and forms, and never restarts or reconfigures the existing local service.
Session presence alone is not work: a listed session holds sleep only when its running execution detail proves work and no permission or form is pending.
The installed file is an inert marker-bearing template. Vendor fields are fixture-tested, not live-verified.
